name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
description: Native radios in a radiogroup fieldset, three sizes and choice cards, with a dot that glides to the chosen option. CSS-only motion.

.rx-radio.transition: border-color 200ms var(--motion-ease), box-shadow 200ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-press-duration) var(--spring-press)

.rx-radio:has(> :checked)::after.transition: opacity calc(var(--spring-swap-duration) * 0.5) var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-swap-duration) var(--spring-swap)

.rx-radio-group-card > .rx-radio-item.transition: border-color 150ms var(--motion-ease), background-color 150ms var(--motion-ease), box-shadow 150ms var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-press-duration) var(--spring-press)

.rx-radio-group::after.transition: top var(--spring-glide-duration) var(--spring-glide), left var(--spring-glide-duration) var(--spring-glide), opacity calc(var(--spring-swap-duration) * 0.5) var(--motion-ease), scale var(--spring-swap-duration) var(--spring-swap)
